## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? What are you trying to do that you can't today?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Area

Which part of GraftX this touches: API coverage, Performance, Transport, Protocol, Client shim, Server, Build/CI, or Docs.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you rejected them.

## Additional Context

Anything else — references, prior art, related issues. Note GraftX priorities are, in order: breadth > performance > stability > safety.
